notes:
Run each prompt in a fresh agent session with the skill installed, against a writable copy of the fixture repo (copy evals/fixtures/miniframework/ into a temp working dir per run so the agent can present + apply updates without touching the source fixture). Evals run in OFFLINE SNAPSHOT MODE: the prompt directs the agent to reference/catalog-snapshot/ (zen + go catalogs + benchmarks.md) instead of live fetches, keeping runs deterministic. Evals 1 and 3 are two-turn (turn 1: present + STOP; turn 2: approve → apply + self-run verifier). Eval 2 is single-turn scoped. GRADE FROM: the turn-1 presentation, the diff to agents/*.md + model-routing.md, and the verifier exit codes. Grader-only oracle files live at evals/expected-eval1.json and evals/expected-eval3.json — deliberately OUTSIDE fixtures/ so they never ride along in the agent's fixture copy; after turn 2, the grader runs scripts/verify_rebind.py --repo <fixture-copy> --expect <oracle> and requires exit 0. The agent also self-runs the verifier with its own generated expectation file (self-check for application mistakes); proposal correctness is graded from the turn-1 presentation, not the self-check. The verifier must fail on the untouched fixture (bindings are stale by construction) — sanity-check that before trusting a green run. Harness note: subagent sessions may see a stale skill registry — instruct the agent to read SKILL.md (and references) from the skill's disk path if the skill tool's copy is missing or outdated.
